scope: Seventeen whole-token except/apart-from forms: 15 osim and two krome in editable Interslavic prose.
choice: Normalize all 17 audited sites to official type-1 kromě, preserving surrounding syntax and capitalization.
motivation: Every site has the same except/apart-from function; the existing source already uses canonical kromě extensively, while osim and unaccented krome form an unnecessary mixed lexical layer.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining osim would preserve a South-only doublet beside the established house form.
Retaining unaccented krome would preserve a noncanonical spelling of the selected lemma.
Changing semantically different poręd beside/in addition was rejected and remains outside this family.

evidence.official_dictionary: Official dictionary row 6207, id 318, gives kromě (+2) as type 1 meaning except.
evidence.semantic_audit: All 17 sentences express exclusion, exception or apart-from/additive exclusion; no unrelated meaning occurs.
evidence.house_controls: Before the edit the four sources contained 76 lowercase kromě and eight sentence-initial Kromě controls.
evidence.protected_domains: No target occurs in a comment, foreign-language span, citation title, URL, proper name or TeX control sequence.

validation.prehashes: All four inputs matched the frozen EDIT-0094 successor state.
validation.coverage: Exact pre-count 17: five book osim, ten base osim and two base krome; every target line matched exactly once.
validation.independent_review: A read-only lexical audit independently reproduced counts, loci, protected-domain classification and successor hashes.
validation.postcondition: Whole-token osim and krome are zero; canonical kromě/Kromě totals 101.
validation.structure: Line counts, braces, ordered TeX controls and math delimiters are invariant; 45-isv.tex and bib-isv.tex are byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: The frozen dry-run successor was reproduced twice before atomic application and matched after application.
